purpose: Separate two reasons Euclidean alignment hurts with Lee2019's 62 electrodes: a badly estimated covariance, or tiny-variance directions blown up by whitening; and ask whether it hurts within one day.
claim_boundary: Exploratory on both datasets: plain alignment's next-day results on both were known when this was planned. The expectations are written before any of these models is trained, but they are not prospective tests. Alignment uses unlabeled next-day trials, which the frozen protocol does not.

M1.statement: With Lee2019's 62 electrodes, plain alignment lowers accuracy on held-out runs of the training day too, so the harm does not come from the change between days
M1.contrast: Lee2019 fold models: ea minus unaligned, held-out runs

M2.statement: ea-top and ea-shrink10 each remove at least half of the harm on Lee2019
M2.contrast: Lee2019 final models, next day: (variant minus ea) over (unaligned minus ea)

M3.statement: The Ledoit-Wolf coefficient is small, so the covariance is estimated well and the harm comes from blowing up small directions
M3.contrast: Lee2019, all 62 electrodes, training day: mean coefficient over participants

references.unaligned: scripts/overfit_study.py full-22 / full-62 (final and fold models), seeds 0-2
references.plain alignment, final: scripts/alignment_study.py full-22-ea (2a) and scripts/replication_study.py full-62-ea (Lee2019), seeds 0-2, next day aligned with all of its trials

variants.ea-shrink10: covariance shrunk 0.1 toward the identity at its mean eigenvalue
variants.ea-lw: the same with the Ledoit-Wolf coefficient, trials as units (mibci.alignment_variants)
variants.ea-top: only directions with eigenvalue >= 0.01 of the largest whitened; the others set to zero
variants.ea-floor: eigenvalues below 0.01 of the largest raised to it before whitening (kept, not blown up); added to the planned design after the smoke test's spectra (see design_note)

design_note: docs/FINAL_EXECUTION_PLAN.md planned ea-top with a 1% floor. Before this plan, the 2a smoke test's spectra (training day) put 16-18 of 22 directions below 1% of the largest, and five Lee2019 participants 45-52 of 62, so ea-top keeps 4-6 (2a) or 10-17 (Lee2019) directions: if it hurts, that shows the small directions carry information, not that blowing them up is harmless. ea-top is run as planned; ea-floor, the same 1% boundary with the small directions kept at that floor instead of zeroed, is added so that the two readings can be told apart. M2 is judged as written (ea-top and ea-shrink10); ea-floor is reported beside it.
next_day_alignment: all of the next day's unlabeled trials (as the earlier studies' ea-all); also its first run (2a, scored on runs 2-6) or its offline run (Lee2019, scored on the online run)
analysis: seeds (and folds) averaged within each participant; 95% participant bootstrap (10,000, seed 690); BCI IV 2a on artifact-free session-2 trials, Lee2019 on all
